ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The query is a clear, neutral explanatory task. Dunlin-235B scores higher on every relevant metric (e.g., MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3, and higher internal eval scores for Summarization and Support Dialogue), and it has a neutral preference (50) for transactional requests with no penalty. Willet actually prefers well-specified transform tasks more strongly, but its lower capability scores make Dunlin the better fit for producing the clear, non-rambling explanation the user explicitly wants.
